messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-5643 fired for service=redwood-inference / rule=inference.p99.latency > 1200ms (3m). Affected region: us-west-2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-5643
jenna (oncall): taking this — i'm oncall for us-west. starting triage now. anyone else seeing spikes? :eyes:
mike-rt: yep, dashboards show queue depth on pool-gpu-2 jumping. p99 tokens/service at 1400ms. looks correlated with a spike in KV cache misses.
jason-eng: digging into model-llama-13b instances. seeing elevated GC time on a subset of pods. logs:
```
2026-03-14T01:02:13Z model-llama-13b pod-7f9a OOM_GC 324ms
2026-03-14T01:03:20Z model-llama-13b pod-7f9a kv_cache_miss=0.42
```
mike-rt: also saw a short network flapping event to one of the edge switches — might be causing retransmits and higher tail latencies.
jenna (oncall): ack recorded in PD. I've muted noisy alert rule for this incident to avoid alert storm. :mute:
pagerduty: Acknowledged by jenna (oncall). Escalation policy: level1 -> level2 @sre-lead in 10m if not resolved.
sre-lead: if metrics don't improve in 10m, escalate and consider cross-region routing to us-east-1 fallback pool. Also check autoscaler behavior, maybe it hit maxBurst.
mike-rt: increasing autoscale min to 4 for deployment=model-llama-13b to soak the queue. Command run:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-llama-13b --replicas=4
```
jason-eng: scaling acknowledged. rolling update in progress, pods launching on g4dn cluster. watching startup logs.
customer-success: CSM flagged 3 customers reporting degraded latency on API. No 5xxs reported yet, just timeouts from SDK at 30s.
jenna (oncall): good to know — marking customer-impact: degraded-latency. Notifying sales ops.
kyle-oc: ping — I can take the handoff in ~8m when my rotation starts. prepping runbook and rollback play.
jenna (oncall): ok i'll start the handoff notes now. current mitigation steps: 1) increased replicas 2) temporarily route 15% traffic to us-east fallback (preview) 3) disable aggressive batching in frontend for affected models.
jason-eng: routing rule applied: feature-flag traffic_split model-llama-13b us-east:0.15 us-west:0.85
mike-rt: initial telemetry: p95 down from 800ms -> 570ms after scaling and traffic split. p99 still sticky at ~900ms but trending down.
sre-lead: good. remove any non-critical background jobs hitting the same pool (batch-embeddings jobs) — coordinated with batch team to pause for 15m.
customer-success: flagged customers updated — they see improvement in recent requests. will keep monitoring and relay customer notes.
jenna (oncall): handing off to kyle-oc now. checklist included in thread. Notes:
- Root cause hypothesis: KV cache miss spike + transient network flapping causing tail retries
- Mitigations applied: scale replicas, route 15% to us-east, pause batch jobs, mute alert
- Customer impact: degraded latency for small number of customers, no widespread 5xx
- Next steps: monitor for 30m, if stable start a postmortem with networking and runtime teams
kyle-oc: on it. running health checks and validating cache warmup across new pods. I'll post a confirm once p99 < 700ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
incident-bot: Note: pagerduty escalation timer reset by jenna (oncall). Next escalation due if no resolution within 20m.
mike-rt: health checks green on new pods. KV cache miss rate falling to 0.12. p99 at 640ms now.
kyle-oc: confirming p99 < 700ms for 3m window. marking mitigation stable. I'm going to keep an eye for 30m then call for resolve.
jenna (oncall): thanks team. adding follow-up action items: create a dashboard alert for cross-pool retransmit ratio and increase autoscaler headroom for this model family.
sre-lead: schedule quick post-incident sync with networking and runtime tomorrow. assign owners: networking -> jason-eng, runtime -> mike-rt.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-5643 status updated: acknowledged -> in_progress -> mitigated by kyle-oc. Please add any final notes.
kyle-oc: marking incident as mitigated. will not close PD until postmortem posted. leaving the channel for now, reachable if needed. :wave:
pagerduty: PD-5643 incident set to RESOLVED (mitigated). Please ensure postmortem in #postmortems with SOC/SEV2 template within 48h.
customer-success: customers notified of mitigation and we will follow up with a brief incident summary.
jenna (oncall): closing loop — thanks everyone for quick coord. I'll draft the incident timeline and initial RCA and drop in #postmortems.
